title: A Typewriter for the Orchard
author: Coral Nystrom
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
